notes: Independent implementation because author code was not available
Synthetic results use an artificial spectral observer and do not establish real-camera CIE accuracy
Model selection uses validation Delta E76; held-out illuminants and reflectances are evaluated
All checks repeated after runtime recovery; final synthetic metrics reproduced exactly
Notebook uses the public model/data/training APIs; all saved test metrics were independently recomputed in the fresh-kernel E2E test

packaging.source_distribution: built; wheel compiled from sdist; executed notebook with 7 PNG outputs included; no README or cache files
packaging.wheel: built and installed in a separate environment containing only this package and NumPy

publication_ci: Linux-only (Ubuntu) on Python 3.11, 3.12 and 3.13; notebook execution on Python 3.12; remote outcomes checked separately

tests.command: python -m pytest -q -m "not notebook" --junitxml=reports/junit.xml (inside the uv notebook environment)
